modules.module_title: Follow work-site health and safety measures

pcs.pc_description: undertake "The Take-5 (Personal Risk Assessment)" before commencement of any work
comply with safety, health and security- related regulations/guidelines at the mine e.g. follow Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for material handling in underground (U/G) mine
operate various types of fire extinguishers to control different types of fire at a worksite when required
check that roof supporting is as per Systematic Support Plan (SSP) and approved Systematic Support Rules (SSR) while undertaking work in an area
take precaution against occupational health hazards (like dust, water, mine gases etc.) due to U/G working environment
use self-rescue apparatus, appropriately when required
follow appropriate emergency response procedure during emergency such as fire, water inrush, fall of ground etc.
follow precautions against U/G electrical appliances
follow appropriate Standard Operating Procedure while working near any isolated and sealed off area of the mine
follow appropriate safety practices while traveling on U/G haul roads, incase of post blast fumes and misfire
follow the manufacturer’s instructions for care and safe operation of mine machinery and equipment
identify the working ventilation district from line diagram of ventilation circuit to direct air to the working face
follow Safety Management Plan (SMP) and Emergency Management Plan (EMP)
follow gas detecting alarm signal on leakage of inflammable gases and laid out procedure to ensure safety
follow process for reporting any unsafe act/condition in work area to the concerned person
use underground mine communication system
ensure positive isolation near the work place if applicable
use appropriate PPE as per the requirement
maintain hand hygiene by washing hands with alcohol based sanitisers/soap
disinfect the machine/tools before and after work/task
maintain hygiene at the work site
report any symptoms of illness to the shift- incharge
identify six directional hazards at workplace and take decisions accordingly
identify the environmental impact of mining related operations and follow steps to reduce those impact
follow the mineral conservation practices in U/G mining operations to achieve optimum ore or mineral recovery
ensure that the stowing practices produce minimum disturbance to the surface
ensure that the subgrade ore is carried out to surface and stacked separately at the earmarked place
ensure the productivity of the machine for material/fuel conservation
follow the process for collecting, storing and disposing of the hazardous material and waste (like used oil, lubricant, battery, etc.) in compliance with worksite guidelines
follow the "5-S" practice at work site like cleaning oil from ground (to avoid soil from getting damaged), etc.

modules.module_title: Assist in conducting the pre-operational checks of the HEMM

pcs.pc_description: assist in visual inspection of the components of HEMM for cracks and wear, and communicate the same to technician/ operator; parameters- unusual noise, vibration, leak, spillage, accumulation, etc.
inspect the bucket for any crack or damage of tooth points, lock pin, etc.
check the hydraulic oil levels, radiator water levels, anti-freeze levels, etc.
check the track chain pad, bolts, and links in crawler mounted equipment and tighten bolts, as required
check if gauges, indicators, and sensor are fully functional and report the same to technician or operator; parameters- alarm message
check for any leakage in compressor unit, airline, and other components
check for any defect in trailing cable and cable joints
carry all the tools and tackles, required for the assigned job

modules.module_title: Assist in conducting routine maintenance of HEMM, automotive fleet, and other machinery

pcs.pc_description: clean the work area and assist the Technician in conducting the inspection of HEMM and automotive fleet
follow all the work instruction from Fitter / Technician related to routine maintenance
ensure that no maintenance task on the engine is performed when running or still hot
repair or replace faulty parts as per Technician or Operator’s instructions
use various kinds of hand held and power- tools to lift, dismantle or assemble machine components
perform greasing & lubrication, as directed by operator/ technician
assist in changing oil, oil filters, air filters and replacing hoses, belts, water pumps, and other parts
check fan belts, hoses, wiper blades, and other safety equipment
assist the Technician in maintaining and repairing the automotive fleet, HEMM, and other equipment
check the air in tires, inflate them, change and repair them, as required
respond to road service calls and tow broken-down vehicles
refuel, wash, and clean machinery, as required
assist in welding services, as needed
assist in fitting of pipes and shifting of pumps

modules.module_title: Assist in shifting and placement of the machine

pcs.pc_description: follow the work instruction for shifting and positioning of underground machinery such as the loader, jumbo drill, low profile dump trucks, etc.
ensure that the path is free from any obstruction
ensure that no blasting operation is in progress in the area to be shifted
carry the trailing cable while placement of machine in case of electrical driven machines
guide the operator for placement of drill machine at distinctly marked position given by Mechanic/Technician/ surveyor
carry out visual inspection of the area before starting the operation
ensure that the dumping area is free from cracks and subsidence
inspect the unloading area properly for any persons or machinery before starting the dumping operation
ensure that no person is present in the unloading/dumping area or in the crusher/chute area, to ensure the area is safe

pcs.pc_description: report any abnormality in the machine operation to the operator
perform water spraying on muck pile, if in practice
clean the operator’s cabin and its glasses for better visibility, before starting the machine in a shift
set-up devices and machine parts, using hand tools

modules.module_title: Assist in installation & operation of the electrical supply system and electrical equipment

pcs.pc_description: follow all the work instruction from Mine Electrician and assist him/her for installation and operation of electrical supply and electrical equipment such as transformers, generators, circuit breakers, etc.
use necessary tools such as screw drivers, pliers, etc. and equipment such as ladder for working at height, cables of required specifications, etc.
put Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO) label and ensure zero energy state before starting the job
ensure proper laying of cable to protect from any damage
ensure proper housekeeping of the area after completion of the job and disposal of the scrap material, as per the guideline of the organization

modules.module_title: Assist in the maintenance of electrical supply system and electrical equipment

pcs.pc_description: assist Mine Electrician in maintenance of transformers, generators, circuit breakers, isolators, bus bars, control panel, switch board, wiring, protective relays etc.
ensure cleaning of electronic components, as per instruction from Mine Electrician or manufacturer’s manual.
assist in replacing the spare parts, as per Mine Electrician’s instructions
replenish/change the consumables, as per service manual/Mine Electrician’s instructions
interpret displayed messages and outputs and share the same with Mine Electrician
perform a visual inspection to verify proper functioning of electronic/electrical components, as per manufacturer’s manual
ensure proper earthing for welding machines and hand tools, as required
